title: Memev trust record, version 1
description: A grant (who trusts which subject, for which purposes, in which scope, between which times) and a revocation (which grant is withdrawn, by whom, from when, and why). PROVISIONAL: the choices come from ADR 8 in docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md, which is proposed, and a change is a new schema version, not an edit of memev-trust/1. Trust is an eligibility input only: a record never grants a permission, a membership or a read, and a personal scope is never shared. The validator and the evaluation are src/engine/federation/trust-record.mjs; the module has no production caller yet.

issuer.description: The subject that grants the trust: a root the evaluation is given, or the holder of a live grant that delegates.

scope.description: One scope. A personal scope is never shared, so it is not a choice here.

purposes.description: The purposes the grant covers, a closed list of two in version 1. PROVISIONAL: two purposes are option A of question 7 in ADR 8, which is proposed, and a further purpose is a new schema version.

delegation.description: A grant with a depth of 1 or more may be delegated from. A delegated grant names its parent, has a lower depth, and only narrows it: the same scope, the same or fewer purposes, an expiry no later than the parent's, a start no earlier than the parent's. PROVISIONAL: narrowing-only delegation to a stated depth is option B of question 9 in ADR 8, which is proposed.

parent.description: The id of the grant this one is delegated from.

revocation.description: Takes effect from its time. It is applied only when its issuer is the issuer of the grant or a root the caller passes, and it makes every grant delegated from the revoked one ineligible. PROVISIONAL: who may revoke is a part of question 6 in ADR 8, which is proposed; this adds no role-by-action matrix.

grant.description: The id of the grant revoked.
